decisions.reason: As a flagship launch tightly aligned with the firm's cloud messaging growth path, it is still strategically important, although its lack of later website visibility slightly raises the chance it could be folded into a broader platform offer.

Document capture and recognition fits the push toward digital document workflows for business and public-sector customers, but the weaker later visibility suggests it is no longer a top standalone priority.
Email and fax conversion remains useful for legacy-heavy and regulated German customers, yet fax-related offers are structurally less future-oriented and more at risk of eventual withdrawal.

Sandbox threat protection still supports the firm's secure communications positioning, though it may increasingly be packaged inside broader security services rather than marketed as a separate product.

Multi-engine virus scanning is a relatively undifferentiated, overlapping security layer with low recent visibility, so it is the most likely candidate to be discontinued and have resources shifted to core platforms and newer development.
